definitions.explanation: Clothes worn for sleeping, including both Western-style pajamas and traditional Japanese nightwear (yukata-style).

examples.japanese: {寝巻|ねまき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
{寝巻|ねまき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}えた→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧。
{寝巻|ねまき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦まま→まま：02007_mama⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}ないで→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't go outside in your sleepwear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{寝巻|ねまき}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{用意|ようい}されている→用意：01746_youi⟧。
examples.english: At the ryokan, a yukata is provided as sleepwear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{寝巻|ねまき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}ってもらって→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んでいた→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: The children were happy to get new sleepwear.

notes:
{寝巻|ねまき} is a native Japanese word for sleepwear, covering both traditional Japanese nightwear and Western-style pajamas.

ALTERNATE FORMS:
- ⟦{寝間着|ねまき}→寝間着：noentry⟧: alternate kanji spelling (same pronunciation)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {寝巻|ねまき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧: to change into sleepwear
- {寝巻|ねまき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦まま→まま：02007_mama⟧: still in one's sleepwear
- {寝巻|ねまき}⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: appearance of being in sleepwear

USAGE:
{寝巻|ねまき} sounds slightly more traditional than ⟦パジャマ→パジャマ：04516_pajama⟧, which is the more common everyday word for pajamas. At ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧, a ⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧ is typically provided as {寝巻|ねまき}.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦パジャマ→パジャマ：04516_pajama⟧: pajamas (Western-style, more common in daily speech)
- ⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧: yukata (often used as sleepwear at ryokan)
- ⟦ナイトウェア→ナイトウェア：26374_naitowea⟧: nightwear (modern loanword, less common)
